text.description_html:
Omnia 985/4BTNUS3 4" x 4"x Square Corners Solid Brass Hinge

Package includes one hinge, matching solid brass flathead, Phillips Drive #12 x 1-1/4" wood screws and standard removable button tip finials.

Fitted with a high grade, removable pin. Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Corners: Square
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Hinge Material: Solid Brass
  • Available Finishes: US3

*Sold individually
